content.answer: Reject a record as stale only when now - ts > max_age (a record exactly at max_age is still fresh and must be accepted); comparing payload presence is not freshness — non-empty payload says nothing about whether the timestamp is current, so always compare now - ts against max_age.
content.reuse_advice: At any ingestion or validation boundary, always compare the record's timestamp against the current reference time: compute now - ts and accept if it is <= max_age, reject if it is strictly greater than max_age. Never use payload presence or non-emptiness as a proxy for freshness; they are orthogonal checks.
